name: Tall Flame
note: The dahlia, pulled up into one flame that leans in the wind.

name: Eye
note: A pointed oval, like an eye or a seed. Points up and down.

name: Four-Point Star
note: Four long points, like the star in the logo.

name: Wings
note: Wide, like open wings. It fills the wide projector picture.

name: Comet
note: A flower with a tail of petals that streams to one side.

name: Galaxy
note: An oval that swirls. The edge turns, the middle stays.

name: Hanging Bloom
note: A drop shape. Long petals hang down.

name: Oval Gear
note: A gear that is an oval.

name: Cam Gear
note: A gear with one side pulled out, like a cam in a machine.
